name: Sample New Variant — Atlas AS7-X Sampler
author: MC2 remaster examples
description: Worked example of the LEGACY zero-code variant-ADD path (S4 of the ADD-path ladder): whole-file-shadows data/objects/atlas.csv with a FOURTH variant block appended at row 314 (23+97*3) — 'Atlas AS7-X Sampler', a distinct loadout swapping two ER Lasers for an ER PPC + ER Large Laser. No engine change, no gate: LogisticsData::initVariants enumerates blocks open-endedly, so the new variant appears in the mech bay and drops in-mission with the mod active. Validated by mc2_modlint --mod (VARC_ chassis-CSV rules) — the 23+97n layout is fragile; run modlint before shipping.
